spec.title: Add directives collapsible to VSCode extension
spec.context: Users cannot see which directives are assigned to which workflow/skill from the VSCode kanban view. They must manually check config.yaml to understand what custom instructions apply to each phase. This feature provides quick visibility into directive assignments directly from the sidebar, allowing users to see at a glance what custom instructions apply to each workflow phase and click to open directive files for editing.

in-scope.item: Collapsible DIRECTIVES section in VSCode sidebar TreeView
Workflow/skill items as collapsible rows with chevron
Directive items as children that open XML files on click
Warning icon for missing directive files
File watcher for auto-refresh on directive/config changes

out-of-scope.item: Editing directives inline in the TreeView
Creating new directives from the UI

requirements.requirement: The system shall display a collapsible "DIRECTIVES" section in the kanban sidebar TreeView, positioned after the Config section and before Product Docs.
The system shall display each workflow/skill (festina-create, festina-scope, etc.) as a collapsible row with a chevron and workflow ThemeIcon.
The system shall display workflow names using convention-based formatting: strip "festina-" prefix and capitalize first letter (e.g., festina-scope becomes "Scope").
The system shall show all workflows including those with no assigned directives, displaying "No directives" text for empty workflows.
When a workflow is expanded, the system shall display its assigned directives as child items with symbol-ruler ThemeIcon.
When a directive item is clicked, the system shall open the corresponding XML file in the editor.
When a directive file does not exist on disk, the system shall display it with a warning ThemeIcon, disable the click handler, and show a tooltip explaining the file is missing.
The system shall automatically refresh the directives view when directive XML files or config.yaml are modified.
